notes: Research 2026-11-13; every source_url opened with WebFetch. No Bahamas veterinary association clinic directory found online (CbVMA page only gives the association contact); Dept. of Agriculture page lists no clinics. No duty rota and no animal poison line found. Not added (only found via directories/aggregators or old news, never opened on the clinic's own page): Freeport Vet Hospital (Poincianna Drive, Grand Bahama; 242-352-8155, emergency 242-727-8381; only on findyello.com; freeportvethospital.net could not be opened - blocked by provenance), Exuma Veterinary Clinic (findyello page failed to fetch twice), Westlake Animal Hospital, Caves Village Veterinary Hospital, Palmdale Veterinary Clinic, Purrfect Pets Veterinary Clinic (only bahamourri/noonsite/yabsta directory listings or a 2016 Tribune article). Abaco: no vet clinic found. Grand Bahama and Exuma therefore have no entry. Baark! Bahamas (spay/neuter nonprofit, mobile clinic) skipped, not a fixed clinic.
